name: 45202 · Cincinnati, OH
findings: ZIP 45202 (Cincinnati) has 519 nonprofit organizations. 214 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 178 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (13% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 45202 (Cincinnati) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
27% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 45202 (Cincinnati) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 10.2 times the typical level).
